prompt: What is the difference between starring a project and sponsoring it?
explanation: Stars are applause — bookmarks that feed discovery. Sponsors are fuel — actual money that keeps maintainers maintaining. Both are visible on the repository; only one pays the rent.

options.text: A star bookmarks it and signals interest; sponsorship sends money to sustain it
A star notifies the maintainer; sponsorship does not
Stars are public but sponsorships are secret
There is no difference — sponsorship is a paid star
